configuration.activeIconPacks: Select an icon pack that enables specific icons.
configuration.arrowTheme: Configure the style of arrow icons
configuration.iconThemeByName: File name, `*.ext` or `folder/` -> id of the installed file icon theme giving its icon. Wins over everything else.
configuration.iconThemeLayers: Other installed file icon themes mixed with this theme, the first listed wins. An entry is a theme id (as in `workbench.iconTheme`, e.g. `material-icon-theme`), or an object with that id and how the theme mixes for files and for folders. Empty to use this theme only.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.files: How the theme mixes with this theme for files.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.folders: How the theme mixes with this theme for folders.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.mode.fill: Only for the names no theme above gives an icon to.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.mode.overr: Its icon wins for every name it gives an icon to, and its default icon too. Your own associations still win.
configuration.iconThemeLayers.theme: Id of an installed file icon theme, as in `workbench.iconTheme`.
configuration.folders.color: Change the color of the folder icons.
configuration.folders.theme: Set the type for the folder icons.
configuration.hideFileIcons: Hide the file icons (folder icons are kept).
configuration.monochrome: Display the file and folder icons in a single color (see monochromeColor).
configuration.monochromeColor: Color of the icons when monochrome is enabled.
configuration.opacity: Change the opacity of the icons.
configuration.saturation: Change the saturation of the icons.
configuration.showUpdateMessage: Show the update message after each update.
configuration.showWelcomeMessage: Show the welcome message after first installation.
configuration.title: Cool Icon
